name: office
description: Multi-session switchboard: session board + tap-in, Codex review handoff, model router/spawner, manga reader

routerBackend.title: Router backend
routerBackend.description: auto tries jev, then claude, then rules; any other value forces that backend (rules stays the never-fail fallback).

routerModel.title: Router model (claude backend)
routerModel.description: Cheap, fast model the claude router backend asks for a JSON routing decision.

jevApiKey.title: AI/ML API key (TypeSafe Jev)
jevApiKey.description: Prefer Keychain: security add-generic-password -a "$USER" -s aimlapi -w (looked up first; then this field, then $AIMLAPI_KEY). Without a key the jev router backend is skipped.

codexPath.title: codex executable
codexPath.description: The codex CLI: a bare name is looked up on PATH, or give a full path.

codexReviewModel.title: Codex review model
codexReviewModel.description: Model for /codex-review and codex_review (run at reasoning effort high).

codexExecModel.title: Codex second-opinion model
codexExecModel.description: Model for codex_exec (run at reasoning effort medium).

codexDeepModel.title: Codex deep-review model
codexDeepModel.description: Scarce model used only by /codex-review --deep or deep: true (effort high); never chosen automatically.

codexRereviewModel.title: Codex re-review model
codexRereviewModel.description: Model for an agent's later codex_review rounds, which check the changes since the last reviewed commit (effort medium).

codexRereviewMaxLines.title: Codex re-review: max changed lines
codexRereviewMaxLines.description: More lines changed than this since the last reviewed commit makes an agent's next round a full review on the review model.

codexMaxRounds.title: Codex review rounds per branch
codexMaxRounds.description: Reviews an agent may start on one branch, the first included; then codex_review is refused. Your own /codex-review is never refused, and counts.

usageAlertPct.title: Usage alert percent
usageAlertPct.description: Alert you once when your Claude or Codex 5-hour or weekly usage window reaches this percent (a toast, repeated to the manager on its next session_usage, spawn_worker or codex_review result). Once per window, across all sessions. 0 = off.

claudePath.title: claude executable
claudePath.description: The claude CLI used for headless workers.

workerWorktree.title: Worker worktrees
workerWorktree.description: auto: a worker started in a git repo runs on its own branch in its own git worktree; off: workers run in the given folder.

workerPermissionMode.title: Headless worker permission mode
workerPermissionMode.description: Passed to claude --bg / claude -p workers as --permission-mode.

maxWorkers.title: Max concurrent jobs
maxWorkers.description: Codex reviews and workers running at once; more are refused.

maxOpusWorkers.title: Max concurrent Opus jobs
maxOpusWorkers.description: Workers on Opus-tier models (opus, fable or their full ids) running at once; more are refused. Codex reviews don't count. 0 sets no limit beyond Max concurrent jobs.

jobTimeoutMin.title: Job timeout (minutes)
jobTimeoutMin.description: A job still running after this long is ended.

messageApproval.title: Message approval
messageApproval.description: When a Claude session messages another via the office mod

budgetSoftFiveHourPct.title: Budget: 5-hour soft line (%)
budgetSoftFiveHourPct.description: From this share of the 5-hour limit, only small routed tasks (haiku, or sonnet at low or medium effort) start as workers.

budgetSoftSevenDayPct.title: Budget: weekly soft line (%)
budgetSoftSevenDayPct.description: From this share of the weekly limit, only small routed tasks start as workers.

budgetHardPct.title: Budget: hard limit (%)
budgetHardPct.description: At this share of either limit no worker starts, unless you type /spawn --force.
